Review round

Retro look, part 1: reviewing Open

We want to know whether the retro print direction (D-001) suits a tool people review in every day, before going further with it.

This part is reviewing, screen by screen. Part 2 is trying the prototype, and the author's side.

Review skillWork through the reviews that came back, one proposal per comment, and close the round when it is done.

Reviewer linkSend reviewers this link. It shows them the round, one item at a time, and nothing else of the workspace; they answer and send their review from it.

Reviewers need the site hosted at an https address; on this computer, npm run serve gives you a link that works for you.
